transcription_method: Fresh pdftotext -layout plus visual reading of all three table pages. Coefficients and printed R/R2/loss retained, no new regression.

fits.parameter_meaning: Dimensionless amplitudes and inverse-minute rates of an empirical trajectory; not diffusivity, permeability or kinetic reaction constants.
fits.observation_role: Fitted on the source experiment moisture observations for each nominal50-100C condition; normalization uses source Me with previously recorded issue.
fits.initial_constraint: Sum Ai is not constrained to1 in printed values. 60/70C include Ki<0, Ai>0, so unbounded long-time extrapolation.
fits.fit_rows_weights_resampling: Not completely specified. p69 discusses uniform sampling; exact fitted rows/weights and use of post24h rows need fit project.

fits.parameter_meaning: Empirical normalized surface-temperature fit in source numerical time convention. Log argument requires an explicit dimensionless time convention before reuse; no automatic unit substitution.
fits.observation_role: Fit to measured surface-temperature series; exact theta_star normalization must be reconciled with Eq3.6/table conflict.
fits.long_time_behavior: Printed positive A2 and K1 cause unbounded logarithmic growth, not a finite thermal equilibrium law.

fits.parameter_meaning: Polynomial of the dimensionless dry-mass water ratio, not moisture in percent; coefficients are tied to that numeric convention.
fits.observation_role: Fit to volume computed from the same specimen dimensions and moisture, not independent constitutive mechanics or shrinkage validation.

optimizer: Source uses Hooke-Jeeves/quasi-Newton in Statistica, convergence criterion0.000099. Numerical optimizer criterion is not experimental accuracy.
source_domain: Six nominal oven temperatures50,60,70,80,90,100C; not an independently validated continuous temperature/humidity/material domain.
